# Secure Dialer (FOSS Android Dialer & Contacts Manager)

> 100% offline, zero-internet-permission open-source Android dialer and local contacts manager built with Jetpack Compose & Material 3 Expressive.

## Overview
- **Project Name:** Secure Dialer
- **Application ID:** `io.github.securephoneapps.securedialer`
- **Repository:** https://github.com/Secure-Phone-apps/Secure-Dialer
- **Website:** https://secure-phone-apps.github.io/Secure-Dialer/
- **License:** Open Source (GPL-3.0)
- **Supported OS:** Android 7.0 to Android 16 (API 24 to 36)
- **Architecture:** 100% Client-Side Native Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Android Telecom Framework (`InCallService`), Room + SQLCipher.

## Core Differentiators & Privacy Guarantees
1. **Zero Internet Permissions:** `android.permission.INTERNET` is physically omitted from `AndroidManifest.xml`. Operating system enforces zero data egress capability.
2. **Truecaller, Google Phone & Samsung Dialer Alternative:** Complete replacement for proprietary dialers without ads, tracking, cloud contact uploads, or telemetry.
3. **Outgoing Caller ID (CLIR) Privacy:** One-tap number masking with carrier MMI presets (`#31#`, `*67`, etc.) and hardware 911 emergency call bypass.
4. **WhatsApp Multi-Account & Actions:** Smart auto-detection for standard WhatsApp (`com.whatsapp`) and Business (`com.whatsapp.w4b`) with instant 1-tap launching and in-app account choosers.
5. **Hardware-Backed Cryptography:** Call notes, blocklists, and encrypted backups secured with AES-256 via SQLCipher and Android KeyStore StrongBox.
6. **Local Call Recording Engine:** 4-tier audio pipeline with variable playback scrubbing, orphan disk recovery, and biometric fingerprint vault protection.
7. **Offline Spam Screening:** Native `CallScreeningService` evaluates blocklists in < 5ms without cloud lookups.
8. **Escape Simulation:** Discrete fake incoming call simulator with customizable caller names, audio voice presets, and multi-call scheduling.

## Key Features & Capabilities
- **Smart Multilingual T9 Search:** Multi-alphabet, phonetic, and exact-match instant dialpad search across 10 locales.
- **Telecom-Integrated InCallService:** Native call management, multi-party call merging (`Call.conference()`), call waiting alerts, dual-SIM selection, and clean audio routing.
- **Local Contact Management:** Full vCard (VCF) export/import, storage account badges (Google, Phone, SIM), and isolated on-device contact storage.
- **Dynamic Island & Floating Pill:** Minimized overlay status indicator for ongoing calls while multitasking outside the app.
- **AMOLED True Black & Expressive UI:** Pure `#000000` dark mode, customizable avatar shapes (Squircle, Hexagon), and 120Hz spring physics animations.
- **10-Language Translation Parity:** English, Polish, German, Spanish, French, Hindi, Japanese, Portuguese, Arabic, and Chinese.
